trigger: First frozen real Safari launch exposed a repository annotation path that remained writable by the product child even though chat memory, session and logs were isolated.
single_repair: Run both the product import probe and product server under a macOS sandbox profile that denies file writes to the safe repository and original dirty checkout while allowing the isolated temporary runtime root.
failure_rule: If the sandboxed import probe or a synthetic write-denial fixture fails, do not launch the server. One post-freeze real rerun is allowed only after this repair passes and is committed.
claim_boundary: The sandbox repair protects repository paths from the product child. It is not a malicious-kernel security claim and does not establish chat quality, tool safety, VRM rendering, or research advantage.
